name: best-workspace
description: BEST Ultimate Workspace & Creative Ecosystem — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,gui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w gui"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w gui
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,gui -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w gui"
